levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Steps are done out of order, for example clearing surfaces before the floor.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four steps are completed in the modeled order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Steps are completed in order and the learner explains why the order matters (floor first avoids re-messing a cleared surface).

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two of the four steps are completed in five minutes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four steps are completed at or near the five-minute mark.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four steps are completed with time to spare, and the learner identifies specifically what made it fast.

lookFors: Items are placed in a specific location, not a single catch-all pile.
The before/after reflection names a specific visible change, not a vague 'it's cleaner.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
